hypotheses.justification: The theorem takes this section variable automatically: it is instance-implicit, its type mentions only q and N, which are already arguments, and there is no `omit` for it in section L2. Nothing in the statement needs it. `PlaceSpecialization` requires only [Fact q.Prime] [NeZero N] [Field k] [CharP k q]. `PlaceSpecialization.fstDiv` (Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_GlueData.lean) is `D.filter P.IsStrictFst`, and its variable block has no Fact (¬ q ∣ N). `modularFunctionFieldBar` takes only N. The claim is just that Finsupp.filter commutes with finite sums, which holds for any predicate. The proof uses only Finset.induction_on, Finset.sum_empty, Finsupp.filter_zero, Finset.sum_insert and the file's lemma `fstDiv_add`. The proof of `fstDiv_add` is `unfold fstDiv; exact Finsupp.filter_add` and never uses the divisibility fact. With `omit hqN in` on fstDiv_sum (and on fstDiv_add, or by calling Finsupp.filter_add directly), the same proof goes through.
